text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then. I guess it's about time for 
me to head home."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I was thinking about it while running... 
but nothing came to mind. A plan to 
revitalize Funabashi—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(...Funabashi Carrot Parfait Stand— 
Funabashi Veggie Sandwich Stall—Funabashi 
Race Fight Song— —At most, that's about 
all I can...)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(......H-Huh? Is this actually pretty 
good? Just now... my head is suddenly 
feeling so clear!??)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Inspiration struck at an inconvenient 
time— with idea after idea popping into 
her head, Furioso ended up staying up late 
into the night."
